about: The shared oracle for 'is this an aoe area handle?'. pentaryn-aoe owns the flags (core.isHandle, core.isHandleTarget). Hand copies elsewhere must agree on the column they implement: creatures' and portals' isAoeHandle = 'prop' (aoe-movement-portals-43, transform-creatures-30); combat's turnflow/helper-token.mjs (shapes.isAoeHandle), senses' light and portals' spreadArrival read the token flag = 'handle'. token/actor are whole `flags` objects (keyed by scope); null = no such document. Columns: handle = the token's own flags.pentaryn-aoe.handle; prop = handle OR the actor's flags.pentaryn-aoe.handleActor; bind = isHandleTarget(a Token placeable); bindActor = isHandleTarget(the token's synthetic actor).
